Website information

Privacy Policy

Last updated: October 7, 2026

This website is designed to collect only the information needed to respond to consultation requests. The contact form is not connected to a submission service until an authorized endpoint is configured.

Information you may provide

This can include your name, email address, business name, website, business type, marketing challenge, service interest, and any message you choose to send.

How information is used

When form delivery is configured, submitted information will be used to review and respond to your inquiry, arrange a consultation, and communicate about the services you requested.

External services

A booking or form service may be added later. Its privacy practices should be reviewed and this notice updated before collecting information through that service.

Your choices

You do not need to provide personal information to browse the site. Contact details for privacy questions should be added before the form is connected for live submissions.
